description: Test file for schema value conversions and equality checks in Kubernetes API extensions, focusing on custom list and map schemas, and their comparison and iteration behaviors.

methods.name: TestEquality
methods.description: Tests equality comparisons between various complex schema-based data structures, including list, map, object, and set schemas.

methods.name: TestLister
methods.description: Tests list-like behaviors such as size, get, iteration, containment, and addition for schema-based list structures.

methods.name: TestMapper
methods.description: Tests map-like behaviors such as size, get, iteration, and containment for schema-based map structures.

methods.name: BenchmarkUnstructuredToVal
methods.description: Benchmark for converting a list of unstructured maps to schema-based values.

methods.name: BenchmarkUnstructuredToValWithEscape
methods.description: Benchmark for converting unstructured data with escape characters to schema-based values.
